evidence.excerpt: TakeCareOS is an AI-first operating system for care agencies. The platform consolidates every function an agency runs on — rostering, shifts, CRM, care notes, messaging, invoicing, timesheets, and compliance — into one place, with AI agents that automate the admin work managers currently do by hand.
